g.text: Recorded involvement: implicated or potentially contributing, drug misuse deaths, Scotland
Source: NRS individual-substance workbook, 2024 edition (published 2 September 2025), SUB1a.
Counts overlap across drugs; not prevalence, first discovery, causation or real-time warnings. Testing changed over time.
